items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: You and Karen both. And I hate for you to have to go back.

ctx.x: I'm going to try. I was sure I was going to get well before now, but I wasn't. I've been in this thing for 12 years now. I don't miss nothin'. I don't miss the stage, I just miss the money that I don't get from the stage. That's the thing. That makes everything coming, you don't know where you're going. You know what I mean? All the bills come in, you don't know where you're going.
